snippet.title: The Rifted Skies | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
The Rifted Skies is an active VR roguelite set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Parkour and fight to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover—can your home ever be saved?

Coming Fall 2026 for Meta Quest and Steam. Wishlist it now!

Meta Quest - https://bit.ly/4oLttha
Steam - https://bit.ly/4eGgSr0
